name: auto-ontology
description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
one_liner: A tool that teaches an AI assistant exactly what a company's database columns and tables actually mean, so the AI stops guessing and gives correct numbers.
buyer: A head of data/analytics at a mid-size company who is rolling out AI chatbots for business reporting and is tired of the AI confidently returning wrong revenue figures.
business_use_cases: A data consultancy sells a 2-week engagement that maps a client's messy warehouse into a certified ontology so their new AI analyst tool stops hallucinating numbers.
An enterprise SaaS company bundles this under the hood so its 'ask your data a question' feature is actually trustworthy enough to show executives.
A fractional data-engineering freelancer offers 'AI accuracy audits' to companies already using an AI BI tool, finding and fixing the queries it gets wrong.

money_ideas.idea: Implementation and certification consulting for enterprises adopting AI-driven analytics.
Ongoing retainer to maintain and expand the ontology as the client's database evolves.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one small business with a messy spreadsheet-based 'database' and build them a tiny ontology layer so their AI chatbot can finally answer 'what were last month's sales by region' correctly.
